repos.name: langwatch/langwatch
repos.description: The platform for LLM evaluations and AI agent testing
repos.one_liner: An observability and evaluation platform specifically designed for LLM applications and AI agents.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for high-performance integration into modern web stacks.
Provides automated evaluation pipelines to measure LLM output quality and consistency.
Enables developers to track agentic workflows and debug complex prompt chains.
Ideal for fintech teams needing audit trails for automated financial advice or data extraction.

repos.name: feder-cr/AIHawk
repos.description: Open-source AI browser agent for web automation, undetected by anti-bot systems: a web browsing agent on a stealth Firefox that is not flagged as a bot, not blocked, and does not trigger captchas. Plain-English tasks, computer-use agent, browser MCP for Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
repos.one_liner: An autonomous AI browser agent designed for stealthy web automation and data scraping.
bullets: Utilizes a hardened, stealth-configured Firefox instance to bypass anti-bot detection.
Automates complex web interactions without triggering CAPTCHAs or security blocks.
Useful for market research, automated price monitoring, and gathering real-time financial data.
Python-based architecture allows for easy integration into existing data pipelines.

repos.name: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
repos.description: Run parallel research agents with any model
repos.one_liner: A framework for orchestrating parallel research agents to synthesize information using any LLM.
bullets: Written in Rust for high-concurrency and memory-safe agent orchestration.
Supports multi-agent collaboration to perform deep-dive research on complex topics.
Modular design allows swapping between different LLM backends for specific research tasks.
Perfect for quant researchers automating the synthesis of financial reports and academic papers.

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repos.one_liner: A spatial intelligence engine that converts WiFi signals into real-time presence and vital sign data.
bullets: Leverages Rust for low-latency signal processing and spatial computation.
Provides non-intrusive monitoring without the privacy concerns of traditional video cameras.
Extracts high-fidelity environmental data from commodity WiFi hardware.
Applicable in smart office infrastructure for occupancy-based energy management and security.

repos.name: 666ghj/MiroFish
repos.description: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
repos.one_liner: A universal swarm intelligence engine designed for predictive modeling and complex system analysis.
bullets: Python-based engine implementing decentralized swarm intelligence algorithms.
Focuses on predictive analytics for dynamic, multi-variable environments.
Designed to handle large-scale data inputs for pattern recognition and forecasting.
Relevant for algorithmic trading strategies that require adaptive, swarm-based market prediction.
